correctness.rationale: From the star metric, all nonleaf nilpotents are exactly A_j, B_i and H_ij (i≠j). Direct composition gives 2c+c²−a1 hub maps commuting with any fixed leaf nilpotent; accounting for both ordered factor positions gives 4c+2(c²−a1), and the hub-hub commuting count is 3m²−m. Each leaf nilpotent is a disjoint union of directed paths, with partition weight m!/∏a_j!, so summation proves the all-size formula. The n=1 boundary is included. Explicit metric-level enumeration checks n=1..6; it is corroborative, not proof.

value.rationale: The number of ordered commuting nilpotent pairs involving the hub is a natural exact invariant of a central finite inverse semigroup family. The source/terminal compatibility criterion supplies structural information and the closed formula isolates the exceptional stratum from an otherwise nontrivial symmetric-inverse baseline. It does not merely restate cardinalities or tabulate small cases, and it applies uniformly to all star orders.
